description_for_model: Generic ServiceNow REST actions (Table API records, schema, statistics, current user, service catalog and ordering, knowledge articles, attachments) for the employee's HR cases, catalog requests and orders, approvals and IT tickets. Use these actions, not knowledge search, whenever the user wants to see, create or change anything in ServiceNow; the agent's skills say which table, query and fields to use.

functions.name: sn__list_records
functions.description: List records from any ServiceNow table (Table API). table: table name, e.g. sn_hr_core_case, sc_req_item, incident. query: encoded query, e.g. 'active=true^opened_for=javascript:gs.getUserID()^ORDERBYDESCsys_created_on'. fields: comma-separated fields to return (default all). limit (default 20, max 100) and offset page through results. display_value: 'false' (raw values, the default), 'true' (labels, e.g. state 'Closed Complete' and people's names) or 'all' (both).

functions.name: sn__get_record
functions.description: Get one record from a ServiceNow table by sys_id. fields: comma-separated fields to return. display_value: 'false' (raw values, the default), 'true' (labels, e.g. state 'Closed Complete' and people's names) or 'all' (both).

functions.name: sn__create_record
functions.description: Create a record in a ServiceNow table. body: JSON object of field names and values. input_display_value=true treats body values as labels (e.g. state 'In Progress') instead of raw values. Returns the created record (with sys_id and number). display_value: 'false' (raw values, the default), 'true' (labels, e.g. state 'Closed Complete' and people's names) or 'all' (both).

functions.name: sn__update_record
functions.description: Update fields of a record in a ServiceNow table by sys_id. body: JSON object of the fields to change; journal fields such as comments and work_notes append an entry. input_display_value=true treats body values as labels. Returns the record after the update. display_value: 'false' (raw values, the default), 'true' (labels, e.g. state 'Closed Complete' and people's names) or 'all' (both).

functions.name: sn__delete_record
functions.description: Delete a record from a ServiceNow table by sys_id. This can't be undone.

functions.name: sn__get_record_types
functions.description: List the ServiceNow tables (record types) available to the user.

functions.name: sn__get_record_schema
functions.description: Get a table's schema: its fields, their types, labels, choices and references.

functions.name: sn__get_table_stats
functions.description: Aggregate statistics for a ServiceNow table (Aggregate API): count records matching an encoded query, optionally grouped (group_by) or with avg/min/max/sum of numeric fields.

functions.name: sn__get_current_user_info
functions.description: Get the signed-in ServiceNow user's details: sys_id, user name, name and email.

functions.name: sn__get_catalogs
functions.description: List the service catalogs the user can see (Service Catalog API). text: optional search text.

functions.name: sn__get_catalog_categories
functions.description: List the categories of a service catalog (catalog_id: the catalog's sys_id).

functions.name: sn__get_catalog_items
functions.description: List or search the service catalog items the user can order (Service Catalog API). text: search text; category / catalog: sys_ids to filter by; limit and offset page through results.

functions.name: sn__get_catalog_item
functions.description: Get one catalog item by sys_id, including its variables (the questions its order form asks: names, types, mandatory flags, choices).

functions.name: sn__order_item
functions.description: Order a catalog item now (Service Catalog API order_now). body: {"sysparm_quantity": "1", "variables": {question_name: value}, "sysparm_requested_for": user sys_id (optional)}. Returns the request number and sys_id.

functions.name: sn__get_knowledge_articles
functions.description: Search ServiceNow knowledge articles (Knowledge API). query: text to search for; filter: encoded query; kb: knowledge base sys_ids; fields; limit.

functions.name: sn__get_knowledge_article
functions.description: Get one knowledge article by sys_id, including its text.

functions.name: sn__get_attachment_metadata
functions.description: List attachment metadata. query: encoded query on sys_attachment, e.g. 'table_name=sn_hr_core_case^table_sys_id=<sys_id>'.

functions.name: sn__retrieve_attachment_metadata
functions.description: Get one attachment's metadata (file name, size, type, record it belongs to) by sys_id.

functions.name: sn__retrieve_attachment_content
functions.description: Download an attachment's content as base64 (files up to 1048576 bytes).

functions.name: sn__upload_attachment_file
functions.description: Attach a file to a record. table_name and table_sys_id identify the record; file_name; content_base64: the file's content; content_type. Max 5242880 bytes.

functions.name: sn__delete_attachment
functions.description: Delete an attachment by sys_id. This can't be undone.
